text: Hey, Squidboy. Did you catch Frankenstein on Channel 37 last night?
Afraid not, my man. As much as I love Boris Karloff, I was much too distracted by the handsome and dashing Jay Buckman to watch TV.
Ooh. Well, then I guess you'll be far too busy to watch the original Bela Lugosi version of Dracula, which is on tonight.
